integrity: Analytic argument proves every finite probability vector in the stated domain; checker is supplementary finite exact-rational corroboration, not an infinite proof. Self-review only.
scientific_limitations: Exact theorem restricted to two independent categorical draws. Does not claim analogous cutoffs for larger samples, estimator consistency, risk superiority, or independent priority. A highly relevant generalized Good–Turing paper was available only by abstract.
title: Five categories are necessary for positive Good–Turing–missing-mass covariance at two draws
